entities.name: Argininosuccinate lyase
observations: The 465-residue query sequence exactly matches curated UniProt protein Q3SUR0 from Nitrobacter winogradskyi (100% identity, 100% coverage, exact sequence hash match).
Curated homologs Q3SUR0, Q1QHU1, and A5EB50 annotate EC 4.3.2.1 argininosuccinate lyase activity and cytosolic localization.
Pfam matches are Lyase_1 (PF00206.26; residues 8-302) and ASL_C2 (PF14698.12; residues 365-434).

entities.name: Argininosuccinate cleavage
observations: Catalyzes 2-(N(omega)-L-arginino)succinate to fumarate plus L-arginine; Rhea RHEA:24020 and EC 4.3.2.1.
The reaction is the final step of bacterial L-arginine biosynthesis from L-ornithine and carbamoyl phosphate.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: Argininosuccinate lyase participates in L-arginine biosynthesis, specifically the final pathway step.

entities.name: Bacterial cytosol
observations: Curated homolog annotations assign the protein to the cytoplasm/cytosol; the sequence lacks a recognizable signal peptide or transmembrane segment in the reported analysis.
